messages:
Ana: Need a final decision on webinar timing for EMEA-friendly hours + captioning support. goal: ship promo tomorrow.

Mei: Proposed time 2026-06-03 13:00 UTC 1 (nice overlap APAC+EMEA). Will that work for Rhea (demo) and panel?

Rhea: 13:00 UTC is OK but Im traveling that day. I can pre-record the live demo and join for Q&A. Prefer we plan a recorded clip + live commentary.

Sam: We can run captions via Zoom live captions + Otter integration. Need speaker consent. Also suggest we schedule a separate 20m caption test in rehearsal.

Jake: Title thought: 'Serve LLMs Faster & Cheaper: Ops tricks that actually move the needle'  keeps benefit-led language.

Mei: Abstract v2 posted in drive (link). Short customer-facing blurb plus a technical appendix.

Lina: Lead routing: landing form should include: email, company, role, demo_ok (checkbox). If demo_ok true => tag `webinar_demo` and route to AE rotation within 24h. Also capture timezone for demo booking.

Ana: Run-of-show draft:
- 0-3m: Intro + housekeeping + caption note
- 3-12m: Benchmark highlights (Mei)
- 12-30m: Demo reel + live commentary (Rhea recorded, Marco live)
- 30-45m: Panel: customer + eng (Tobias + Rhea)
- 45-55m: Live Q&A + poll
- 55-60m: CTA & next steps

Sam: Rehearsal schedule:
- caption test (20m) 
- tech check (30m)
- full dress (60m)
Ill send invites. ops-bot will attach streaming creds.

ops-bot: ops-bot: caption test slot proposed 2026-06-01 09:30 UTC; tech check 2026-06-02 10:00 UTC; full dress 2026-06-03 11:00 UTC. Please confirm.

Mei: For the demo reel  we need pre-baked KV-cache scenario + failing node fallback so its clear in video. Marco can annotate with callouts.

Marco (Runtime Eng): Will produce annotated clip (90s) + full backup. I'll include a short shell snippet in the runbook to trigger fallback:
```
# simulate overloaded replica
curl -X POST https://demo.local/run -d '{"key":"cold"}' --header 'X-Debug: force-fallback'
```
Keep the snippet in the runbook.

Rhea: I'll record voiceover and upload MP4. I can join for panel remotely if bandwidth OK.

Lina: SDRs want the exact CRM tags and a template for the first outreach. I'll paste the AE template here once Mei confirms the demo CTA language.

Jake: Marketing assets needed list: landing H1 + hero image; short social copy + 3 tweet variants; LinkedIn post; confirmation email; reminder email + SMS option. I'll handle social + emails. Need hero image by EOD.

Mei: I'll create a simple benchmark visual (png) sized for socials and the hero. Uploading now.

Ana: Accessibility note: we should mention captions on the landing page and in the confirmation email. Good PR.

Sam: Also recommend a short behind-the-scenes Slack channel for day-of ops and a single point-of-contact who will trigger backup clip if needed. Who wants ops lead?

Marco: I'm happy to be ops lead for the demo path and will be on standby first. Sam can press stream controls.

Ana: Actions recap:
- Mei finalize abstract + hero by EOD
- Marco produce annotated demo + shell snippet + upload backup
- Rhea record voiceover + upload MP4
- Jake build landing + emails + social copy (hero asset from Mei)
- Lina configure form + CRM tags + AE template
- Sam book caption test + rehearsals + create ops slack channel
All confirm here when done.

Mei: Confirmed. Hero uploaded.

Marco: Confirmed. Demo upload complete.

Rhea: Confirmed, upload done and I'll join panel if network OK.

Lina: Confirmed, I'll post AE template in the channel.

Jake: Draft landing up  will share link for QA.

Sam: Rehearsals scheduled and invites sent.

Ana: Great. If no objections I'll finalize the event page and start promos tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
